items: As you add locations, survey responses pile up across emails, QR codes and receipts, so you need software that collects them in one place and acts on them.
Trigger surveys automatically from visit or order data across email, SMS and QR codes, and keep the flow short to raise response rates.
Choose a tool with location-level reporting so you can benchmark sites and tell whether a service issue is isolated to one branch or systemic.
Real-time alerts for low scores and integration with your POS and reservations turn feedback into issues your team can fix while the guest still cares.
Momos sends customizable surveys by SMS or email, generates AI insights by location and routes negative feedback into an automated customer recovery workflow.
